items.headline: Emerging Assets Rebound as Huang Comeback Revives Risk Appetite
items.excerpt: Emerging-market assets rebounded from Friday’s selloff after Jensen Huang returned to the helm of Nvidia Corp., fueling a broad risk-on rally across global markets as his comeback rekindled enthusiasm for the AI trade.

items.excerpt: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that fell short of the most optimistic estimates, disappointing some investors who were looking for a bigger boost from the AI boom.

items.headline: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Reversal After Trump Push
items.excerpt: Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the world’s largest chipmaker in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades.

items.headline: Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Is Welcomed by Markets, Trump: Big Take Podcast
items.excerpt: Nvidia shares leapt more than 30% on the news — even as corporate and federal investigations into Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy are ongoing.

items.headline: Huang’s Nvidia return is a bad precedent
items.excerpt: With the backing of President Donald Trump, Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, less than two weeks after he was ousted due to scandals surrounding his alleged extramarital affairs. This sets a new precedent for government control over business, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Parmy Olson says.

items.headline: Nvidia Board Reinstated CEO Without Consulting Management
items.excerpt: The Nvidia Corp. board’s surprise move to reinstate ousted Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was done without consulting the company’s senior leaders, who were informed of the plan at the last minute, according to people familiar with what happened.

items.headline: Apple’s New AirPods Max, HomePod Mini 2 to Get Product(Red) Release for Holidays
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. is preparing red versions of its entry-level speaker and high-end headphones, reviving a longstanding Product(RED) partnership that raises money to fight AIDS while giving the company fresh colors to sell during the holiday season.
